title: Sign-out invalidates the project session; the provider redirect is a configured option
asA: operator who has signed in through the project's OAuth2 sign-in surface
iWant: a sign-out request to clear my project session on the server and in the browser
soThat: the next request from this browser is unauthenticated regardless of what the provider still holds

acceptanceCriteria.description: A POST to the sign-out route invalidates the session handle server-side and clears the session cookie in the browser.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a session issued from US-10101 and a project route at `POST /auth/sign-out` wired to the flow controller
acceptanceCriteria.when: the browser dispatches the sign-out request
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response clears the session cookie (`Set-Cookie` with the cookie name, empty value, `Max-Age=0`, `HttpOnly`, `Secure`, `SameSite=Lax`); the session-record store no longer holds a record for the pre-signout session handle; the next protected-route request from this browser is refused as unauthenticated even if the browser replays the pre-signout cookie value

acceptanceCriteria.description: When a provider record sets `providerLogout: 'redirect'` and declares `endSessionEndpoint`, sign-out returns a 302 to that endpoint after clearing the project session.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a mock provider whose declaration sets `providerLogout: 'redirect'` and carries an `endSessionEndpoint`, and a session issued against that provider
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response status is 302; the `Location` header equals the declared `endSessionEndpoint` (with the configured `post_logout_redirect_uri` and, for OIDC providers, the `id_token_hint` query parameter as the raw id_token stored on the session record); the session cookie is cleared on the same response

acceptanceCriteria.description: A provider record that sets `providerLogout: 'redirect'` without declaring `endSessionEndpoint` refuses boot with a stable-coded error.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project config that sets `providerLogout: 'redirect'` on a provider record whose `endSessionEndpoint` field is absent
acceptanceCriteria.when: the flow controller's provider validator runs at boot
acceptanceCriteria.then: the boot terminates with error code `OAUTH2_LOGOUT_NOT_DECLARED` naming the provider id; no server process is left listening; the audit log records one `oauth2.provider_config_refused` event carrying the provider id and reason class `logout-endpoint-missing`
